title: viola tricolor var. derelicta
intro: Viola tricolor var. derelicta, commonly known as Heartsease, is a variety of the pansy flower that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory function. Heartsease is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Heartsease include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide benefits for cardiovascular health and cognitive function.
